arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, but it currently only shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a short bio, a photo, and maybe some info about your interests or work to make it feel more personal and engaging. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's great that you share your love of hiking! To make it more engaging, you could add posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, and tips for fellow hikers. Keep it up!
